Use the Makefile targets:

- `make test-fast` runs `pytest -m "not postgres" -q`. It skips tests marked `postgres`, so it needs no database. This is the project's recommended default.
- `make test` runs the full suite with `pytest -q`. The `postgres`-marked tests are included, so you'll need a Postgres instance available.

I didn't run either target. To run a single test, call pytest directly, for example `pytest path/to/test_file.py::test_name`.
